dataset: IMPC BCM mouse X-rays, raw download

stages.title: Organize the dataset
stages.does: Finds the images, genotype file and tables; maps every image to its line; adds covariates; splits lines into train and test.
stages.result: 8819 images from 8819 lines, 718 markers + 99 covariate columns (sex, date-of-experiment), 9 traits; 0 images unmatched

stages.title: Image preprocessing
stages.does: Surveys every image; removes legends; excludes inverted, duplicate and off-view images; corrects drift between imaging setups.
stages.result: 8807 training images written, 12 excluded, 22 subjects larger than the canvas; scale normalised over 6 source_size groups

stages.title: Segmentation and traits
stages.does: Chooses what to measure on every real and generated image.

stages.title: Genetic encoding
stages.does: Chooses how the genotype is encoded for the model.

stages.title: Training setup
stages.does: Sizes the model and writes the cluster jobs; never trains on the laptop.

stages.title: Quality control
stages.does: Watches the training curves for collapse, divergence and memorisation; picks the checkpoint.

stages.title: Statistical analysis
stages.does: Generates images for held-out lines and scores them against the truth and genomic prediction.
